queries.name: Movies by two actors together
queries.sql:
SELECT m1.name AS movie_name, m1.date AS release_date
FROM movies m1
JOIN casts c1 ON m1.id = c1.movie_id
JOIN people p1 ON c1.person_id = p1.id
JOIN jobs j1 ON c1.job_id = j1.id
WHERE p1.name = :actor1_name AND j1.name = 'Actor'
INTERSECT
SELECT m2.name AS movie_name, m2.date AS release_date
FROM movies m2
JOIN casts c2 ON m2.id = c2.movie_id
JOIN people p2 ON c2.person_id = p2.id
JOIN jobs j2 ON c2.job_id = j2.id
WHERE p2.name = :actor2_name AND j2.name = 'Actor'
ORDER BY release_date DESC NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m1.name AS movie_name, m1.date AS release_date

JOIN people p1 ON c1.person_id = p1.id
JOIN jobs j1 ON c1.job_id = j1.id
WHERE p1.name = 'Chris Evans' AND j1.name = 'Actor'

SELECT m2.name AS movie_name, m2.date AS release_date
FROM movies m2
JOIN casts c2 ON m2.id = c2.movie_id
JOIN people p2 ON c2.person_id = p2.id
JOIN jobs j2 ON c2.job_id = j2.id

queries.name: Top successful movies in a year(in millions of USD)
queries.sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, (m.revenue / 1000000) AS total_revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = :year
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit_val;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, (m.revenue / 1000000) AS total_revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = 2024
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

queries.name: Top successful movies of all time in a particular genre(with revenue in millions of USD)
queries.sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, ROUND(m.revenue / 1000000, 2) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
JOIN movie_categories mc ON m.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN categories c ON mc.category_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = :genre_name
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, ROUND(m.revenue / 1000000, 2) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
JOIN movie_categories mc ON m.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN categories c ON mc.category_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = :genre_name
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT :limit;

queries.name: Top movies of a movie series
queries.sql:
SELECT m1.name AS movie_name, ROUND(m1.revenue / 1000000, 2) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m1
JOIN movies m2 ON m1.parent_id = m2.id
WHERE m2.name = :movie_name AND m1.kind = :kind
ORDER BY m1.revenue DESC NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m1.name AS movie_name, ROUND(m1.revenue / 1000000, 2) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m1
JOIN movies m2 ON m1.parent_id = m2.id
WHERE m2.name = 'James Bond - 007' AND m1.kind = 'movie'
ORDER BY m1.revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

queries.name: Movies from a Specific Year
queries.sql:
SELECT m.id, m.name, m.vote_average, m.votes_count
FROM movies m
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = :year_val
ORDER BY m.vote_average DESC NULLS LAST,
         m.votes_count DESC NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m.id, m.name, m.vote_average, m.votes_count
FROM movies m
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = 2025
ORDER BY m.vote_average DESC NULLS LAST,
         m.votes_count DESC NULLS LAST;

queries.name: Movies by two Actors together
queries.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, (m.revenue / 1000000) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
JOIN casts c1 ON m.id = c1.movie_id AND c1.person_id = (SELECT id FROM people WHERE name = :actor1_name)
JOIN casts c2 ON m.id = c2.movie_id AND c2.person_id = (SELECT id FROM people WHERE name = :actor2_name)
WHERE c1.job_id = (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE name = 'Actor') AND c2.job_id = (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE name = 'Actor');
queries.original_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, (m.revenue / 1000000) AS revenue_in_millions
FROM movies m
JOIN casts c1 ON m.id = c1.movie_id AND c1.person_id = (SELECT id FROM people WHERE name = 'Tom Hanks')
JOIN casts c2 ON m.id = c2.movie_id AND c2.person_id = (SELECT id FROM people WHERE name = 'Meg Ryan')
WHERE c1.job_id = (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE name = 'Actor') AND c2.job_id = (SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE name = 'Actor');

queries.name: Movies by Actor in a particular language
queries.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.date
FROM movies m
JOIN casts c ON m.id = c.movie_id
JOIN people p ON c.person_id = p.id
JOIN job_names jn ON c.job_id = jn.job_id
WHERE p.name = :actor_name AND jn.name = :job_name
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM movie_languages ml
    WHERE ml.movie_id = m.id AND ml.language = 'en'
)
ORDER BY m.date DESC NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.date
FROM movies m
JOIN casts c ON m.id = c.movie_id
JOIN people p ON c.person_id = p.id
JOIN job_names jn ON c.job_id = jn.job_id
WHERE p.name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio' AND jn.name = 'Actor'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM movie_languages ml
    WHERE ml.movie_id = m.id AND ml.language = 'en'
)
ORDER BY m.date DESC NULLS LAST;

queries.name: top movies of genre in year
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    m.id,
    m.name,
    m.vote_average,
    m.votes_count
FROM 
    movies m
JOIN 
    movie_categories mc ON m.id = mc.movie_id
JOIN 
    categories c ON mc.category_id = c.id
WHERE 
    c.name = 'Comedy' AND 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.date) = :year
ORDER BY 
    m.votes_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;
